svg.title: Whose values train AI: 22 of 51 people named compassion, care or kindness first
svg.desc: Fifty-one small figures, one per person interviewed in Vancouver's Downtown Eastside in March 2026. One by one, twenty-two of them light up red: the people who answered compassion, care or kindness when asked: If AI could learn one thing from human beings to make the world better, what should it learn?
svg.text: “If AI could learn one thing from human beings to make
the world better, what should it learn?”
The same category was absent from
51 interviews, Downtown Eastside, Vancouver, March 2026 · doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19582415
